rawContent: Time is running out to stop catastrophic #climatechange. Our leaders have let us down - but people worldwide are taking action, from community energy to #schoolstrikes. Join me & @friends_earth to demand that the UK Government takes urgent #climateaction. https://t.co/KHTHJ54bBm

We're facing a #ClimateEmergency. Trees can help. Join the call for more #TreesforClimate by signing this @friends_earth petition demanding a UK government commitment to double tree cover: https://t.co/stnlnA043n
